data.description: When the creature takes damage in combat, on its next turn it can fly into a rage as a free action.  It gains +2 Constitution and +2 Strength, but takes a -2 penalty on AC.  The rage lasts as long as the battle or 1 minute, whichever is shorter.  It cannot end its rage voluntarily.
data.name: Blood Rage
